svg.text: How far each version got
Bloons TD 6, Monkey Meadow, Hard Standard (rounds 3 to 80, 100 lives); ruleset btd6-open-v1 unless the row names another. Each dot is one
run, green if it won; the bar reaches the best run.
Hollow dots: runs affected by a known issue (see the table notes).
Camo
round 24
MOAB
round 40
BFB
round 60
ZOMG
round 80
Jev only
Leak pressure from the bloons on the track (no waiting while bloons are past 60% of the
track or lives were lost, when a defence purchase is affordable), pops counted only for
the track each tower reaches, coverage with each tower's own range
MOAB readiness: from 4 rounds before a MOAB-class round, no starting or waiting while
the towers' MOAB damage per second over the first half of the track is short of what the
round needs and a purchase that adds it is affordable; MOAB damage per option in the
question
v4 with graded game speed (--speed graded)
v4 under ruleset btd6-open-v2
v4 plus fixed rules that later revisions extend (each revision is described in
docs/PLAN.md and policy-v6.mjs). The first two: waiting gives way to the most probable
purchase when more than half of Jev's probability is on purchases, and no new placements
(other than the hero) while 12 or more towers are placed. Later ones, with one life
(CHIMPS, or Hard Standard in zero-leak mode): when a coming round is short of pops,
camo, Lead or MOAB damage, the options are cut to the purchases that answer it, saving
for one when none is affordable. v6 under ruleset btd6-open-v2 with graded game speed
(--speed graded)
v6 under ruleset btd6-open-v3 with graded game speed (--speed graded)
v6 revision 2 under ruleset btd6-open-v3 with graded game speed (--speed graded)
v6 revision 3 under ruleset btd6-open-v3 with graded game speed (--speed graded)
v6 revision 4 under ruleset btd6-open-v3 with graded game speed (--speed graded)
v6 revision 5 under ruleset btd6-open-v3 with graded game speed (--speed graded)
v6 revision 14 under ruleset btd6-open-v3 with graded game speed (--speed graded)
v6 revision 18 under ruleset btd6-open-v3 with graded game speed (--speed graded)
v6 revision 18 under ruleset btd6-open-v3 with graded game speed (--speed graded) in
zero-leak mode (--zero-leak: played as if with 1 life)
Jev + prepared playbook
v4 plus a playbook Claude wrote before the match: tower targets, cash holds and threat
answers by round range, with branches for leaks, surplus cash and missing spots,
enforced by claude-v1's filters; near ties within 0.05 go to the playbook's pick; no
Claude calls during the match. Playbook v5 with graded game speed (--speed graded)
Playbook v5 revision 2 under ruleset btd6-open-v2 with graded game speed (--speed
graded)

Jev + Claude strategist
v4 plus a Claude strategist: a build order of tower targets by round range with
priorities, cash holds, threat answers and the hero; off-plan purchases removed while an
on-plan one is affordable; v4 survival rules first; consults at the start, before
threats and MOAB windows, after big leaks and every 10 rounds. Claude v1 with adaptive
game speed (--speed adaptive)
Claude v1 revision 4 under ruleset btd6-open-v3 with graded game speed (--speed graded)
Claude v1 revision 6 under ruleset btd6-open-v3 with graded game speed (--speed graded)
Claude v1 revision 7 under ruleset btd6-open-v3 with graded game speed (--speed graded)
Not listed: four records from a match-ID race at load (bridge 0.3.6, fixed in 0.3.7) and four starts a store ad blocked (fixed in 0.3.10); the runner made
no move in them.
Every run listed up to 2026-09-30 19:24 UTC used the first MOAB requirement, which asked for about 2.9 times the damage needed to kill each MOAB-class
bloon before the exit; it fired in 72 rounds of the logs against 22 with the current requirement (afb132a, 4f0d9c0; docs/PLAN.md, "MOAB requirement
replay").
